MATD.description: Design Material - KDS-41-20-2022 RC (MATD_RC). Modify-only (PUT) payload patching an existing Type="C" concrete material; CONCRETE.CODE and REBAR.CODE drive whether grade lookups auto-fill values (Standard) or the user supplies name/strength (None).

CODE.description: Concrete code kind (None | Standard). Enum tokens are case-insensitive. Standard => CodeName="KS-RC22(KDS-41-20-22)", GRADE auto-fills FC; None => NAME + FC come from request body.

STANDARD_CODE.description: Standard design code (must be 'KS19(RC)' when CODE=Standard).

GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Concrete grade name (e.g. C30) -- required when CODE=Standard.

NAME.description: [CODE=None] User concrete name -- required (non-empty) when CODE=None.

FC.description: [CODE=None] Concrete compressive strength fck (>0); auto-filled from grade lookup when CODE=Standard.

LAMBDA.description: Lightweight modification factor lambda (in [0.75, 1.0] when LIGHTWEIGHT=true; silently forced to 1.0 when LIGHTWEIGHT=false).

CODE.description: Rebar code kind (None | Standard). Enum tokens are case-insensitive. Standard => Rebar_CodeName="KS-RC22(KDS-41-20-22)", grades auto-fill FY/FYS; None => user supplies names + FY/FYS.

STANDARD_CODE.description: Standard rebar code (must be 'KS19(RC)' when CODE=Standard).

MAIN_REBAR_GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Main rebar grade (e.g. SD400) -- required when CODE=Standard.

MAIN_REBAR_NAME.description: [CODE=None] Main rebar user name -- required (non-empty) when CODE=None.

SUB_REBAR_GRADE.description: [CODE=Standard] Sub rebar grade (e.g. SD400) -- required when CODE=Standard.

SUB_REBAR_NAME.description: [CODE=None] Sub rebar user name -- required (non-empty) when CODE=None.

FY.description: [CODE=None] Main rebar yield strength fy (>0); auto-filled from grade lookup when CODE=Standard.

FYS.description: [CODE=None] Sub rebar yield strength fys (>0); auto-filled from grade lookup when CODE=Standard.
